description: The file defines a controller class for managing the 'Free Shipping' extension in the OpenCart e-commerce platform's admin interface. It includes methods for displaying the configuration page and saving settings related to free shipping.

classes.name: Free
classes.description: Controller class for the Free Shipping extension configuration in the admin panel, providing methods to display and save shipping settings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the configuration page for the free shipping extension, setting up data and breadcrumbs.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the shipping extension settings via POST request and returns a JSON response.
